note: Set A binds values to the correct member types and detail locations more often, correctly identifying C3X6 as a channel, W10X12/W10X15 as beams and HSS4X4X1/4 with detail conditions (C1/C2, A5), and it captures the 11 1/2" framing spacing that B omits. Set B covers some facts A misses (W8X10, PL5X3/8, PL 4 1/2X4 1/2X1/2, L3X3X1/4, the 1 1/2"=1'-0" scale) but mislabels C3X6 as a "Beam", assigns L4X4X5/16 to roof framing without support, invents "clearance" readings for bare 1" dimensions, and cites a nonexistent "Detail 2". A's weaknesses are invented bindings (1 13/16" as a duct opening width, 5/8" as bottom clearance, 10" as the depth of a C3X6 member) plus several redundant/vague restatements of the 1/4" TYP thickness. On balance A has more correctly bound, condition-carrying claims and fewer outright misbindings.
